description: This file manages the 'bStaMld' component, including creation, updating, and deletion of MLD instances, handling MLD change events, and configuration parameter handling for a wireless LAN system.

methods.name: s_mldIdExists
methods.description: Checks if an MLD with a given ID exists and returns its object if found.

methods.name: s_createDmInstance
methods.description: Creates or reuses a DM instance for a given MLD.

methods.name: s_updateDmParams
methods.description: Updates the DM parameters for a given MLD, including MAC addresses and affiliated STA list.

methods.name: s_clearDmParams
methods.description: Clears DM parameters for a given MLD.

methods.name: s_mldChange
methods.description: Handles MLD change events, creating or clearing instances based on event type.

methods.name: wld_bStaMld_update
methods.description: Updates all bSTAMLD instances by calling s_updateDmParams on each.

methods.name: s_setEMLMREnabled_pwf
methods.description: Sets the EMLMR enable configuration parameter.

methods.name: s_setEMLSREnabled_pwf
methods.description: Sets the EMLS R enable configuration parameter.

methods.name: s_setSTREnabled_pwf
methods.description: Sets the STR enable configuration parameter.

methods.name: s_setNSTREnabled_pwf
methods.description: Sets the NSTR enable configuration parameter.
